raw_text: The IDF is conducting operations to repel the Hamas attack and secure Israeli communities near the Gaza border. Reserve forces are being mobilized on an emergency basis. We are at war. The enemy will pay an unprecedented price. Ground operations are underway to clear infiltrators from multiple communities in the south.
clean_text: IDF conducting operations to repel Hamas attack and secure border communities. Emergency reserve mobilization. Ground operations to clear infiltrators from southern communities.
